item.title: Warm weather continues in Carolinas with record highs possible
item.description: The Carolinas will experience warm temperatures and possible record highs this week, with a few showers expected over the weekend and even warmer temperatures possible next week.

item.title: Chemical leak at Silfab Solar Facility in Fort Mill cleaned up, officials call for 'thorough investigation'
item.description: The South Carolina Department of Environmental Services is calling on Silfab Solar to stop receiving additional chemicals and pause its startup process following a chemical spill at its Fort Mill facility on Tuesday.
